name: Photo Kano
source: Kazuya Maeda is a second-year high school student who takes pictures of girls with his camera that he received from his dad. The game focuses on his romantic encounters with various girls at his school.
translation: 前田和也是一名高中二年级学生，父亲送给他一台相机，他便用它为女孩们拍照。游戏围绕他与学校里形形色色的女孩之间的恋爱邂逅展开。
